base_url.description: Backend API origin. Endpoints are prefixed with /api, so this must be the origin root without a path.

web_app_url.description: Deprecated Web shell URL. The client derives <base_url>/app; keep this parameter only for older app builds.

minimum_app_version.description: Forces an update when the installed version is lower. Must never exceed the version currently live on the store.

android_store_url.description: Store link used by the forced-update screen on Android.
